# RegisterBox

Business registration preparation and compliance workspaces in India. Based in Bengaluru.

- [Services](https://www.registerbox.in/services)
- [Contact](https://www.registerbox.in/contact)
- [Privacy and service information](https://www.registerbox.in/policies)

Application drafts are not government submissions. Confirm scope and fees with the team.

## Free public tools

- [GST calculator](https://www.registerbox.in/tools/gst-calculator): Add or remove GST at a user-selected rate, with taxable value, CGST/SGST/UTGST or IGST and paise rounding. Does not classify rates or calculate cess.
- [GST invoice generator](https://www.registerbox.in/tools/gst-invoice-generator): Prepare an ordinary domestic forward-charge tax invoice with line discounts and GST; print or save PDF locally. No IRN, signed QR, GSTN submission or live taxpayer verification.
- [HSN/SAC and GST rate finder](https://www.registerbox.in/tools/hsn-sac-gst-rate-finder): Search locally bundled official schedule entries. Results include descriptions, conditions, effective dates and source notifications. Coverage is stated; no match is not an exemption or a default rate.
- [Income tax regime calculator](https://www.registerbox.in/tools/income-tax-regime-calculator): Compare old and new regimes for supported 2025–26 and 2026–27 individual ordinary slab income, including deductions entered, rebate, marginal relief, surcharge, cess and rounding. Special-rate and other excluded income requires a full computation.
- [TDS calculator](https://www.registerbox.in/tools/tds-calculator): Supported resident non-salary payments for 2025–26 and 2026–27; payer eligibility, PAN cases, thresholds, aggregate catch-up, rent and whole-property calculation. Does not file statements or pay tax.
- [GSTIN validator](https://www.registerbox.in/tools/gstin-validator): Offline standard PAN-based format, state code, PAN-pattern and checksum checks for up to 100 entries. Live legal name, registration and active status remain not checked; verify them on the official GST portal.
- [GST late fee calculator](https://www.registerbox.in/tools/gst-late-fee-calculator): Estimate missed GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B returns across a month range using the first missed period or last filed month, last missed period, filing date, filing history, state, nil category and turnover band. Shows each return, ordinary due date, GSTR-1 subtotal, GSTR-3B subtotal, combined fee and CGST/SGST split. QRMP starts only from January 2021; older quarterly GSTR-1 and monthly GSTR-3B are distinguished. The old/cancelled-registration worksheet requires verification of filing history, the effective cancellation date and notified due dates. Ordinary estimates are not confirmed portal dues; interest, extensions, waivers, amnesties and filing restrictions require separate checks. Range and history workflow reviewed 29 October 2026.
- All seven tax tools require no account, payment, tax-calculation API or uploaded documents. Calculations and reference search run locally; entered facts are not added to URLs or persisted by the tools. Rules and sources reviewed 28 October 2026. Results depend on the disclosed scope and facts, not a guarantee of compliance.

- [Free tools](https://www.registerbox.in/tools): Public directory of RegisterBox browser tools. The business licence checker, PDF converter and Indian language typing tool open directly without login or a payment step.
- [Free Business Licence & Registration Checker for India](https://www.registerbox.in/tools/business-licence-checker): Answer simple questions about your state, business activity, sales, turnover and employees to build a starting checklist for GST, FSSAI, Udyam / MSME, Shops and Establishments, IEC and local permissions. Available in [English](https://www.registerbox.in/tools/business-licence-checker), [Hindi](https://www.registerbox.in/tools/business-licence-checker/hi) and [Kannada](https://www.registerbox.in/tools/business-licence-checker/kn). No account, payment, name, phone number, identity document or file upload is required. Results explain their conditions, next steps and official sources; exact state, city, premises and sector requirements still need verification. The checker is guidance, not a government approval or a complete legal opinion. Optional professional assistance is separate. Reviewed 28 October 2026.
- [Indian language typing](https://www.registerbox.in/tools/indian-language-typing): Type familiar words with English letters and convert their sounds into a selected Indian script. This is phonetic transliteration, not translation of English sentences. Twenty language/script choices have local word predictions with ranked suggestions; eight choices are explicitly basic sound mapping. English pronunciation and Indian-word input styles are available. The page explains controls, first-use model download, examples and limitations. Review spelling and names before sharing the text.
- [Free PDF converter](https://www.registerbox.in/tools/pdf-converter): A browser tool for files up to 5 MB combined (5,000,000 bytes). No login, conversion fee or watermark. Convert JPG/PNG/WebP images, Excel XLSX/CSV, Word DOCX, PowerPoint PPTX, TXT/Markdown/RTF and OpenDocument ODT/ODP/ODS to PDF. Export PDF to PNG images, XLSX, DOCX, PPTX or TXT. Image to Excel uses local printed-English OCR with a table preview, review warnings and raw recognised text. The page includes a 12-conversion support table, instructions, privacy information and processing limits. Reviewed 29 October 2026.
- File contents are processed on the user's device and are not uploaded to RegisterBox or a conversion service. Users must download results before leaving or refreshing the page.
- PDF to Word, Excel and text requires existing selectable text. The separate Image to Excel mode uses local English OCR; unclear scans, handwriting, other scripts and complex layouts require review. PDF to PowerPoint produces slide images rather than editable slide elements. Office and spreadsheet layouts are approximations; advanced formatting, charts and media may be simplified or absent. PDFs generated from source files contain image pages.
- PDF inputs support up to 50 pages; Images to PDF supports up to 20 source files, while Image to Excel accepts one image. Additional browser, image, spreadsheet and archive limits apply. Legacy DOC/PPT/XLS, password-protected files, macros and active or externally linked Office content are unsupported. See the tool's visible format guide and FAQ for current details; it is not a universal or pixel-perfect document converter.

## Free CA tools for India

- [CA and accounting tools](https://www.registerbox.in/tools/ca-tools): Public collection of 14 browser tools for chartered accountants, accountants, tax practitioners and businesses. Groups tax/accounts, GST checks, and documents/reconciliation. No login, subscription or paid calculation API. Results depend on the stated scope and entered facts; the tools do not file returns or connect to government or bank accounts.
- [44AD and 44ADA presumptive income calculator](https://www.registerbox.in/tools/presumptive-tax-calculator): Check resident/entity eligibility, ordinary and enhanced receipt limits, exactly-5% cash boundary, 6%/8% qualifying turnover portions and 50% professional income. Supports FY 2025-26 and tax year 2026-27; final tax and audit/ITR eligibility require separate computation.
- [Advance tax and interest calculator](https://www.registerbox.in/tools/advance-tax-interest-calculator): Cumulative instalment targets, dated tax-component payments, 234B/234C or new-Act 424/425 interest and ₹100 base rounding. The single 15 March schedule is restricted to eligible 44AD/44ADA equivalents, excluding 44AE. Unexpected-income exceptions, special extensions and assessment adjustments need review.
- [GST ITC set-off calculator](https://www.registerbox.in/tools/itc-set-off-calculator): Allocate confirmed eligible IGST, CGST and SGST/UTGST credit under the permitted utilisation order, with remaining credit and ordinary cash required. No local cross-use. Excludes RCM, cess, interest/fees and cash/ledger restrictions; it does not certify ITC or debit ledgers.
- [GSTR-2B vs purchase-register reconciler](https://www.registerbox.in/tools/gstr-2b-reconciler): Import local CSV/TSV/XLSX tables, map fields, compare supplier GSTIN/document keys, dates and amounts, and export differences/duplicates for review. A matched record is not proof of ITC entitlement. Combined source limit 5 MB; no GST portal fetch.
- [Bank statement PDF to Excel](https://www.registerbox.in/tools/bank-statement-to-excel): Extract reviewable transaction data from supported local statement files, map bank columns and test running-balance differences before XLSX export. Scans and complex layouts require review; not bank-account access or a guarantee of lossless conversion.
- [Invoice image or PDF to Excel](https://www.registerbox.in/tools/invoice-to-excel): Extract reviewable invoice text and selected header/total fields from local PDFs or supported images, verify values and export Excel. OCR/layout errors remain possible; not complete line-item accounting or GST validation. Source limits are shown in the tool.
- [E-invoice applicability checker](https://www.registerbox.in/tools/e-invoice-applicability-checker): Check covered documents against preceding-year PAN-wide turnover, the exceeding-₹5-crore threshold and supplier exclusions. Shows supported 30-day IRP reporting restrictions separately. Does not create an IRN or decide B2C dynamic QR duties.
- [E-way bill validity calculator](https://www.registerbox.in/tools/e-way-bill-calculator): Estimate validity using entered distance, ordinary 200 km or ODC/ship 20 km increments and IST calendar-midnight rules. Does not measure a route, decide applicability, generate or extend a bill. Compare actual portal Valid Upto.
- [GST place-of-supply finder](https://www.registerbox.in/tools/place-of-supply-finder): Explain selected domestic goods and service branches, including bill-to/ship-to, unregistered-goods invoice-address rules and SEZ inter-State treatment. Imports, exports, multiple-State allocation and unlisted branches need review; not a universal rate/exemption decision.
- [GST reverse-charge checker](https://www.registerbox.in/tools/reverse-charge-checker): Scoped domestic director, advocate legal-service and GTA freight branches, with exemptions/elections and unknown-fact review. It does not cover every RCM entry or calculate tax/ITC. Buying from an unregistered supplier is not by itself a universal RCM trigger.
- [Income-tax depreciation calculator](https://www.registerbox.in/tools/depreciation-calculator): Ordinary WDV for selected continuing asset blocks in FY 2025-26 and tax year 2026-27. Tracks additions, put-to-use dates, the less-than-180-day half rate and closing WDV. Excludes disposals, special rates, additional depreciation and Companies Act useful-life calculations.
- [ROC/MCA additional-fee calculator](https://www.registerbox.in/tools/mca-additional-fee-calculator): Normal AOC-4/MGT-7 annual daily fees and selected ADT-1/MGT-14 delay bands, using a user-confirmed due date and normal fee. Current official relief and portal preview must be checked before displaying a selected total. No LLP/charge/capital forms or adjudication penalties.
- [Karnataka employee professional-tax calculator](https://www.registerbox.in/tools/karnataka-professional-tax-calculator): Monthly salary/wages threshold ₹25,000 inclusive, ₹200 ordinary monthly and ₹300 February for supported FY 2025-26/2026-27. Full-year exemptions must be verified. Professional/business enrolment tax and employer penalties are separate.
- [Draft P&L and balance-sheet generator](https://www.registerbox.in/tools/financial-statements-generator): Paste an adjusted unclosed trial balance, classify accounts, preserve contra balances and generate profit/equity/asset/liability summaries with CSV/print output. Blocks unequal debits and credits; adds no balancing plug. Draft management summaries, not complete statutory or audited financial statements.

## Published service prices and secure payment

RegisterBox service fees are final: no GST is added. Government fees, tax dues and statutory charges are separate unless a package explicitly includes them. Registration details are submitted to RegisterBox first; the package review and Razorpay payment step follow. A payment receipt does not prove government submission, approval or filing.

- [GST registration — ₹1,999](https://www.registerbox.in/services/gst-registration)
- [FSSAI Basic Registration — ₹1,999](https://www.registerbox.in/services/fssai-food-business): application assistance for one new registration at one eligible premises, including the first annual ₹100 government registration fee. No GST is added. State/Central licences are quoted separately. New certificates issued from 1 April 2026 have perpetual validity; annual fees and applicable compliance continue. Future annual fees, extra premises, modifications, testing, audits and local permissions are outside this package.
- [Udyam optional assistance — ₹499](https://www.registerbox.in/services/udyam-registration): official Udyam registration is free. The applicant completes official identity verification; never share OTPs.
- [Shop & Establishment assistance — ₹4,499](https://www.registerbox.in/services/shop-establishment-registration)
- [Income tax filing — ₹1,999 per agreed return](https://www.registerbox.in/services/income-tax-filing)
- [MCA compliance — ₹9,999 for one agreed year](https://www.registerbox.in/services/mca-compliance)
- [Trademark filing packages — from ₹1,899](https://www.registerbox.in/services/trademark-registration): government fees separate; single mark/class as described.
- [Digital signature packages — ₹2,100](https://www.registerbox.in/services/digital-signature): individual or organisation signing, two-year certificate and USB token subject to issuing-authority verification.
- [GST and proprietorship packages](https://www.registerbox.in/services/proprietorship): ₹1,499 registration and one agreed filing month; ₹7,899 proprietorship/GST for one agreed year; ₹19,899 one-year GST filing and ITR. No automatic renewal.
- [Eligible nil GST filing — ₹0 RegisterBox service fee](https://www.registerbox.in/services/free-nil-gst-filing): complete books, period eligibility, filing authorisation and actual acknowledgement remain necessary.
- [Machine-readable service catalogue](https://www.registerbox.in/service-feed.json): package amounts, inclusions and billing periods.

Company, LLP and other services without published fixed packages require an agreed quote. Checkout and customer workspaces are private flows; public service and guide pages contain crawlable prices and scope.
